reason: A DeepSeek Harness UI plugin that adds a searchable Git branch selector to the chat composer, including branch status, creation, tracking, and switching actions.

summaries.zh: 在聊天输入框中提供可搜索的 Git 分支选择器，并支持查看分支状态、创建分支和切换分支。
summaries.en: Adds a searchable Git branch selector to the chat composer with branch status, creation, tracking, and switching actions.

capabilities: Displays local and remote Git branches in the chat composer
Reads branch upstream and ahead/behind status
Creates and checks out new Git branches
Switches the working tree to selected branches
